# BTicino C300X Integration v2.5.0

## Unreleased

The status page offers direct buttons for the other visible pages below the
weather. They also work without a weather entity and use the already loaded
dashboard, without additional requests.

Agenda shows the next five ongoing/upcoming events in seven days from selected
HA calendars. Background reads and a bounded five-minute HA cache keep slow
calendars from blocking controls; no new device polling is added.

Leave home shows explicitly selected contacts, lights and configured actions,
with optional existing Alarmo readiness. Opening the page never executes an
action. Every selected action needs a second **Confirm** tap within eight
seconds; leaving, changed data, busy state or disconnection cancels confirmation.

All regular and optional pages have configurable positions from 1 to 11.
Defaults are Energy 2, Agenda 10 and Leave home 11; equal positions put those
optional pages in that order before regular pages. Each optional page is
independently enabled and retains its selections and position while disabled.

Native controls include capability-based detail controls and offline feedback.
Energy charts expose the exact selected recorded interval and supplied values,
using compact HA history without fabricated intermediate measurements.

The removed Distribution view is replaced by an **opt-in Consumers view**:
top ten configured electrical devices by current W, descending in two columns
of five, independently scaled bars and stable HA-like colors. Measured zero
has an empty bar; unavailable readings are omitted. It does not query recorder
history. Existing Distribution selections are removed, not mapped to Consumers;
other selected views stay selected. Enable Consumers explicitly after upgrading.
An empty selection keeps Energy configured but hidden, with no view updates.

The standard per-entry Notify service accepts `info`, `warning` and `error`,
with independently bounded wake and sound durations from 0 to 300 seconds.
Defaults are 30 seconds wake and sound for all three severities; set either
duration to zero to disable that effect. Effects are restricted to safe Home/HA screens; calls, Alarmo and
other protected contexts block them. No GUI connection means failure, not a
queue for the next wake. Exactly one POST is sent; acceptance confirms transport
only, not physical wake or sound. This is supplementary information, **not a
fire alarm or other life-safety system**. See the
[Notify contract](../../docs/feature-reference.md#standard-notify-service).

## Reliability and access

Failed GUI restarts restore the previous display files. Update cleanup and
read-only remount failures are reported instead of being treated as success.
These checks do not prove GUI readiness or protect against every later crash.
Display request ownership and cleanup preserve the device's Qt 4 constraints.

Notify calls require administrator access or a trusted automation context.
Failed acknowledgements remain visible for explicit retry. Stale webhook and
card completions cannot change a replacement runtime or call. Lovelace repairs
preserve configuration when its current contents cannot be read.

Agent requests reject redirects without forwarding credentials. Connection edits
must match the confirmed device identity; discovery cannot replace a saved
identity without verifying the saved endpoint. Display commands and diagnostics
from an ended runtime are discarded. Failed display-bridge registration is
retried during renewal, without repeatedly configuring a healthy bridge.
Saving an older options dialog preserves newer connection settings. Recovered
entries reload once after their configuration is updated atomically; late
discovery responses cannot recreate subscriptions after unload.
Native-camera microphone support cannot remain enabled without video or on an
unsupported Home Assistant version, including when options are edited concurrently.

Calendar work and display payloads are bounded; disabling or reconfiguring
Agenda releases its resources. The HA quality checklist now distinguishes
verified rules from remaining gaps and does not claim an official tier.

## Upgrade and validation

The matching **2.5.0 native agent and complete display bundle** are required;
update both and reapply the Display patch when upgrading. This version remains
unreleased. Local tests and strict simulations are not hardware proof;
Notify hardware validation is pending.
